title: Map SGI capabilities to components, goals and available resources
requirements:
- Distinguish SGI governance capabilities from the Terminology Service, LIMR and other components and organisations that realise them
- Reference, for the SGI capabilities, the tools, programmes and SDO engagement pathways countries can use to operationalise them
- Trace each capability to the Appendix C component requirements and the Section 3.7 conformance model
- Keep references non-exclusive and vendor-neutral
- Show which capabilities contribute to the seven priority health goals
- Tie Appendix F to a named release of the machine-readable architecture model with persistent capability identifiers
